facts.fact: Paradigm Initiative's table of national digital strategies lists the Ministry of Digital Transition (with the Ministry of National Education and ARTCI) as lead institution for the SNDN 2021-2025; no act or text assigning the mandate is cited.
The report ties national budget allocations of about USD 91 million (CFA 55.6 billion) for 2024 and USD 101 million (CFA 60.78 billion) for 2025 to the implementation cycle of the SNDN 2021-2025.

The report describes the SNDN 2021-2025 as a costed strategic document with matched programmes and puts the total digital strategy envelope at an estimated USD 3.3 billion; the date of the estimate is not given, so the report's publication date is used.
